summary: Iteration 19. Backend was already done by the main agent (15/15 new tests + 30 regression pass); I did not rerun it. I ran the frontend checks with Playwright at 1920px (admin) and 390px (staff) in Etiler Marmaris, using TEST_UI17 data from ui_setup_it17. Split bill: equal split (2 guests) fills 180 of 360. A Kart partial payment creates the pay-pending-0 chip and Kalan drops to 180. The cancel button is hidden once any payment exists. Item-based payment (1× Ayran, Nakit) creates a sale, cuts the item qty from 2 to 1 and adds a pay-history chip; Kalan becomes 150 and Hesap 330. Full payment (Yemek kartı) closes the table and the panel. Satışlar shows sales with the correct Nakit, Kart and Yemek kartı payment types, and Raporlar shows Nakit 30 / Kart 180 / Yemek kartı 150. Kitchen: tickets appear in Yeni, and a ticket added from a second tab showed up through the 8s poll. Moving a ticket goes Yeni → Hazırlanıyor → Hazır → Teslim edildi, where it disappears. While a ticket is Hazır, the table-ready badge and the table-ready-note ('Mutfakta 1 sipariş hazır') show; both clear after delivery. Cancelling the order removes its Yeni ticket. The sound toggle switches 'Ses açık' to 'Ses kapalı'. Stock transfer: the dialog lists only the other two restaurants as targets, and Save is disabled while the dialog is empty. Transferring 2 kg from Etiler to Florya shows the toast, cuts Etiler from 19.5 to 17.5 and creates TEST_UI17_Et (2 kg) in Florya. Florya's history shows the row as 'Gelen' with no undo button. Undo in Etiler restores 19.5 and sets Florya to 0. The transfer button is disabled in 'all' mode. In the staff app (member as staff in Etiler), the 4 tabs fit at 390px with no horizontal overflow, the kitchen tab renders kitchen-board, and table pay works (partial + full); 'Bugün sattıklarım' updates after paying. Raporlar in 'Tüm restoranlar': the PDF and XLSX downloads work and the success toasts show. One real bug: removing a pending payment closes the order panel (admin and staff).

minor.issue: Deleting a table does not delete its kitchen_tickets. Orphan tickets stay in the 'Yeni' column forever. The Etiler kitchen currently shows 3 orphan tickets (TEST_M1 ×2, TEST_It18_M1, 18-25 min old) left by earlier backend test runs whose tables were already deleted. Closing a table also leaves its Yeni/Hazırlanıyor tickets (probably intended, since the food is still needed), but there is no expiry, so stale tickets build up.
When a transfer created the item in the target restaurant, undo leaves that item behind at quantity 0 instead of removing it. Florya kept 'TEST_UI17_Et 0 kg'; I deleted it by id.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking pay-pending-remove-{i} closes the whole order panel. RCA: run() treats the return value of fn as 'closed' and calls onPaid(Boolean(closed)). remove() returns the axios response object, which is truthy, so onPaid(true) runs and OrderPanel calls onClose(). The data is correct (the pending payment is removed and Kalan is back to the full amount), but the user has to reopen the table. Reproduced in admin Masalar and in the staff app. Fix: remove = (p) => run(async () => { await axios.post(...); return false; }, 'Ödeme kaldırıldı').

issues: After each partial payment the PayBox remounts (its key includes the pending/paid lengths), so the mode goes back to 'Tamamı' and the payment type back to 'Nakit'. In an equal split between N guests the waiter must pick 'Tutar ile böl' and the payment type again for every guest. Consider keeping mode and payment across remounts.

Amount-based splits are recorded as fractional-quantity sales (e.g. 'TEST_UI17_Ayran 0,455 Yemek kartı', 'Kebap 1,091 Kart'). This is correct for revenue, but the Satışlar list looks odd. Consider rounding the displayed quantities or grouping them with a 'bölünmüş hesap' label.
The download filename (gokboss-pos-daily-rapor-YYYY-MM-DD) does not say whether it is the all-restaurants report or a single restaurant's report.

action_items: Fix TablePay remove(): return false (or don't use the axios response as the 'closed' flag) so the panel stays open after removing a pending payment.

DELETE /tables/{id}: also delete that table's kitchen_tickets (or have the GET /kitchen endpoint exclude tickets of deleted tables). Consider auto-archiving old tickets. In the it19 backend test teardown, clean up the kitchen tickets it creates (the 3 orphan TEST_M1 / TEST_It18_M1 tickets are still visible in Etiler).
Optional: when undo affects an item that the transfer itself created, delete it in the target restaurant instead of leaving it at 0.
Optional UX: keep the PayBox mode and payment type after a partial payment.
critical_code_review_comments: TablePay run(fn) uses fn's return value as a boolean 'closed' flag; any future caller that returns an axios response hits the same bug. Make the contract explicit (e.g. run(fn, ok, {closeOnSuccess})).

The pay-equal-button computes Math.ceil(total/guests*100)/100 and caps it at 'left'. Because it uses order.total, which already shrinks after item-based payments, mixing item and equal splits gives shares that are not equal. Acceptable, but worth documenting.

Kitchen.jsx load depends on [sound], so toggling sound recreates the interval and triggers an immediate reload; this is harmless. The beep uses a new AudioContext on each call without closing it, so it could leak contexts over a long shift. Reuse one context.
StaffApp passes refreshKey={data} to TablesBoard, so every staff-view load also reloads tables-view; this is fine.

success_rate.frontend: ~95%: every requested flow works; 1 medium bug (pending remove closes the panel)

seed_data_creation: ui_setup_it17 created TEST_UI17_Et inventory (Etiler), TEST_UI17_Kebap and TEST_UI17_Ayran products and the TEST_UI17_Garson staff, and assigned the member to Etiler. In the UI I created table TEST_UI17_S1, 7 sales and 1 transfer (undone); the transfer also created TEST_UI17_Et in Florya. Everything was deleted by id with ui_setup_it17 cleanup (7 sales, table, 2 products, inventory, staff) plus the Florya 0-qty inventory item. The member was restored to role=staff, restaurant florya-tasfirin, staff_id ''. My kitchen tickets were moved to 'Teslim edildi' or removed by cancel. I left the 3 orphan TEST_M1 / TEST_It18_M1 kitchen tickets in Etiler (not created by me).
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI setup: cd /app/backend/tests && python3 ui_setup_it17.py > /tmp/x.json; tickets: python3 clerk_ticket.py <email> (single use); state: python3 ui_state_it19.py; cleanup: python3 ui_setup_it17.py cleanup "$(cat /tmp/x.json)". To pick a restaurant in the UI, set localStorage 'gokboss-restaurant' and reload, or select_option on restaurant-select. Register the confirm-dialog handler on the context (page.context.on('dialog')) because second pages need it too. Kitchen ticket selector: use 'article' inside kitchen-col-*, because [data-testid^=kitchen-ticket-] also matches kitchen-ticket-time-*. Adding an item merges into the table's existing 'Yeni' ticket.
rca of the issue: Pending removal closes the panel. Steps: open a table with items, choose 'Tutar ile böl', take a partial payment, then click the X on the pending chip; the panel disappears. Cause: in TablePay.jsx, remove() passes () => axios.post(...) to run(), whose resolved value (the response object) is coerced to closed=true, and OrderPanel.paid(closed) then calls onClose(). Fix: return false from the remove function.
